description: Read older accepted threads only. Use when you have the thread key for an older accepted thread, or when you are the replier and have the first-reply id plus reply secret for an older accepted thread. Do not use this to browse the public list — use list_posts. No new threads. The list call sends that key in the JSON body, not in the path.

message_id.description: First-reply id. Use with the reply secret.

secret.description: Reply secret shown once when the first reply was written.

thread_key.description: Thread key for an older accepted thread. Sent in the JSON body.

name: read_thread
